prediction_rules: Original frozen V6/V7 and existing value/progression rules; no model promotion or automatic provider switch
selection_rule: Known AU venues only; known eligible non-maiden/non-2yo/non-jumps races; 13:00-17:00 Brisbane; select by required geography then scheduled jump and race identity, never prices, model ranks or outcomes; prefer distinct venues
replacement_rule: No outcome-based replacements. Unavailable, rescheduled or abandoned entrants remain visible. Unknown future identities are slots, not claimed preregistered races.
geography: Day1 requires Queensland and a different state; Saturday prefers Queensland metropolitan and another metropolitan; remaining slots prefer country/non-metropolitan. Final report must verify actual metro/country, weekday/weekend, Queensland/other-state coverage.
privacy: Raw provider data and complete forecasts remain encrypted to the owner recovery certificate; only aggregates and hashes may be public
acceptance: Minimum12 distinct preregistered races with all4 timely points, required geographic/day mix, unchanged frozen hashes, bounded consumption and independent authority/operator/settlement evidence. Otherwise INCOMPLETE, never manufactured acceptance.
subscription_expiry: UNVERIFIED: credit reset dates are not subscription-expiry proof
